mediaWork.summaryNotes: Landmark Peabody Award-winning investigative podcast hosted by Sarah Koenig (Serial Productions / The New York Times). Season 1 reinvestigated the 1999 murder of Hae Min Lee in Baltimore and the conviction of Adnan Syed, examining alibi witnesses, cell-tower evidence, and witness credibility.
